card.name: Words introducing evaluation or assessment clauses
card.fires_on: Verbs and linking words in clauses about evaluating, determining or endorsing, such as "evaluate", "determine whether", and "procedures that are not". Seen in trial-phase descriptions, animal-study statements and web health disclaimers.

modes.label: Evaluate in trial or study aims
modes.description: The verb evaluate (or the words right after it) when describing what a trial phase or study is meant to assess.
modes.example: the trial is then repeated with a larger group to further<< evaluate>> its effect and safety.

modes.label: Disclaimer linking words
modes.description: Words such as "are" and "not" in disclaimers about procedures or uses that are not recommended, endorsed or listed.
modes.example: This article may contain information on medical procedures that<< are>> not recommended or endorsed by Catholic Health Partners

modes.label: Determine whether in label text
modes.description: The word whether after determine in statements about whether subjects respond differently.
modes.example: to determine<< whether>> they respond differently from younger subjects.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it weakly suppresses quality-related words and promotes assorted word fragments.
card.plain: It fires on the wording used to say that a trial or study will assess something, or that a use is not endorsed.
